entries.title: Find words in a card with ⌘F
entries.body: Press ⌘F, or the magnifying glass beside Maximize, to find words in the card you are reading, a card you read again, or a task's record. Type and every match lights up in the title, the card's words, its folded sections and its thread, counted one by one. Enter or ⌘G goes to the next match and Shift+Enter or ⇧⌘G to the previous one; a folded section opens to show its match. Case, accents and curly quotes don't matter, and Esc closes the field. On Linux and Windows the keys are Ctrl+F and Ctrl+G by default; under a key preset without them, press the magnifying glass and use Enter.
